name: Library Organizer
description: Builds and orders collections automatically from genres, tags, countries, studios and more, and shows them as home screen rows.
overview: Rule-based collections, ordering and home screen rows.

versions.changelog: Leave-out fields, audio language rule, automatic genre and country collections, home row sorting, preview, templates, auto-sync after new media. Fixes default rules duplicating on every settings load.
Settings page now has its own entry in the dashboard sidebar and a save-and-sync button.
Home screen rows through Home Screen Sections, a per-rule toggle, and a setting for items per row.
